svg.title: Lead finder pipeline
svg.desc: Lead finder pipeline: Discover (~60 agents, 1,440 trade x city searches), Verify (~35 agents: place page, newest reviews, closure and website web search), Audit (~15 independent agents), line-type check (NANPA then Twilio Lookup, cached), output leads.xlsx with Tier A and Tier B. Qualifying bar: no website (3 proofs), at least 25 reviews, at least 4.0 stars, newest review within 3 months, at least 6 reviews in the last 12 months.
svg.text: A lead must pass all five:
